story: As a registered user, I want to reset my password via email so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: A reset link is sent only if the email belongs to a registered account.
The reset link expires after 30 minutes.
The reset link can be used only once.

reference_test_cases.title: Unregistered email gets the same response and no email
reference_test_cases.expected: Generic 'if the account exists, an email was sent' message; no email is sent; response does not reveal account existence

reference_test_cases.title: Reset link rejected one second after 30-minute expiry
reference_test_cases.preconditions: Registered user a@example.com; reset requested at T0
steps: Open the reset link at T0 + 30m 1s
reference_test_cases.expected: Link rejected with an 'expired' message; password unchanged

reference_test_cases.title: Reset link cannot be reused
reference_test_cases.preconditions: Registered user a@example.com has a valid reset link
reference_test_cases.expected: Second use rejected; new password remains in effect

notes: Format example only, not part of the golden set. LLMs usually miss account-enumeration and single-use checks.
